required: complete reviewed confirming code set for EACH explained incident
two independent reviewed inspections/inspectors/source IDs and records PER incident
required verified-only topology path present and untruncated
verification.discovery: Union requested IDs, previous assessment classified IDs and actual concerned-asset inspection reports; per-record as_of and occurrence attribution; cap20 including retrospective basis fails closed
verification.independence: Distinct inspection/inspector/source/record plus disjoint evidence lineage; retrospective derivative cannot corroborate its own basis
verification.authority: Reviewed domain-qualified discriminating observations alone create causal evidence edges. Unreviewed support may yield POSSIBLE; unreviewed contradiction alone yields INCONCLUSIVE and cannot reject. Mixed positive/negative claims yield INCONCLUSIVE.
verification.meaning: Each observation has one category and named incident attribution. A multi-observation report can occupy multiple categories. Contextual records retain source references/hashes, never gain causal edges by existence.

storage.proposal: Readable Hypothesis.statement; strict original command/expectations/mechanism in PROPOSES source Evidence journal
storage.assessment: Append-only HypothesisAssessment.rationale JSON snapshots and previous ID; actual HAS_ASSESSMENT/SUPPORTED_BY/CONTRADICTED_BY
storage.inspection: INSPECTS source request journal binds investigation/department; no invented direct edge
storage.report: Inspection PRODUCED Evidence ESTABLISHES Finding, strict report JSON/content hash/attributed operation
storage.recovery: PREPARED Evidence operation journal plus one fenced domain batch/COMMITTED receipt/revision/audit; unknown outcome inspected before explicit same-request retry

timestamps: Canonical UTC Z, microsecond datetime comparisons; evidence knowledge/validity as_of, assessed_at actual recording clock; no historical mutable-node reconstruction
permissions: Trusted internal typed actor/reviewer context only; no public authentication, MCP writes, dispatch, worker or B15 events
active_graph_gate: Production source is retained B04 city; B08/B09 disposable guards differ, common writable target only civicly_knowledge. Same-active-graph B08/B09/MCP acceptance gate required before B10 live investigator; no canonical promotion or graph merge during B09-R. See docs/evidence/B09R-ACTIVE-GRAPH.md.
remaining: All18 requirements binding; agents B10, source knowledge B11, planning/auth B12/B13, dispatch/monitor B14, durable events B15

semantic_versions.assessment_v1: Read unchanged historical meaning; no new classification field emitted or historical rewrite
semantic_versions.assessment_v2: rule_version2, explicit classification/uses and matching causal-edge lists
semantic_versions.report_v1: No explicit attribution field; preserve original report/command/journal hash shape
semantic_versions.report_v2: Explicit typed occurrence or retrospective attribution; absent new optional fields excluded from old serialized models
semantic_versions.assessment_v3: Compatible format2 classification envelope; rule3 for new MISSED_PICKUP/ILLEGAL_DUMPING in controller-bound S05/S06, requiring actual dated typed service provenance. Generic rule2 and stored rule1/2 histories preserved; no rule2 pickup-before-deposit inference.

occurrence_attribution.bindings: Actual EXPLAINS/CONCERNS must match original proposal; INSPECTS request journal -> Investigation INVESTIGATES Incident binds reports
occurrence_attribution.direct: Concerned asset with domain subtype and OBSERVED result; named incident interval [started_at,ended_at). Open unresolved incident permits later observations. Terminal without end is uncertain. Overlapping occurrences require explicit named attribution.
occurrence_attribution.retrospective: Independent review, rationale, explicit target IDs within request investigation and 1..5 earlier reviewed direct inspection records with matching asset/code/dated occurrence binding. No recursive retrospective basis. Derivative source cannot create independence.
occurrence_attribution.cutoff: All source/current-version visibility, report recording and observation chronology preserved. Future records excluded; no mutable historical state reconstruction.
occurrence_attribution.storage: Typed metadata in existing immutable attributed report/journal JSON; no new schema property, state, relationship or migration
